hints.title: Interval Intersection
hints.text: Two numbers can be transformed into the same value if their interval spans overlap.

hints.title: Condition on Values
hints.text: For two sorted values, their ranges overlap if and only if the difference between them is at most 2 * k.

hints.title: Two Pointer Range
hints.text: Sort the elements and find the longest contiguous range where the rightmost minus leftmost does not exceed 2 * k.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting followed by a sliding window over values differing by at most 2 * k.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining all subsets or intervals pairwise takes quadratic or exponential time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n log n) time due to sorting and O(1) extra space beyond the sort implementation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Translate the interval overlapping condition into a standard two pointer window problem on a sorted array.
